services.name: New Exhibits
services.desc: Hines Elementery School bicentennial quilt - Mrs. Felt's Class - 1976 and 1st Grade Class 1976-1977 The Harney County Historical Society is proud to announce a New Exhibit to the Harney County Musuem. This old Harney County jail cell arrived on September 6, 2023, from Central Oregon. The item was discovered on an ebay posting and was for sale. The seller was contacted, and arrangements were made to purchase the item after verifying its authenticity. This proved to be fairly easy as the cell had an engraving. This bar reads as follows: ORIGINAL OLD HARNEY COUNTY. BURNS OREGON. OBTAINED BY JOHN WOOSTER. BOUGHT BY WAYNE
